coordinates: World X physical forward, Y left, Z up. Quaternion wxyz. Negative pitch about body Y raises the front.
joint_zero: Current root geometry CAD offsets; standing is the solved entry pose.
interpolation: Monotone cubic Hermite; harmonic same-sign secant tangents, zero endpoint tangents. Hold final position after duration.
contact_model: Current complete sole hull minimum Z; preserved contact choreography and explicit sequential stance preparation for body support.
wave_posture: Reuse the corrected Sit exactly, lift and extend the front-left leg for three smooth waves, replace the foot, and reverse Sit into standing.

h_Part002.sign: positive right-hand rotation about local X

alpha_Part006.axis: Negative local Y of mechanism frame for increasing alpha

theta_Part005.axis: Negative local Y of mechanism frame for increasing theta

joint_conventions.provenance: Measured rig transforms and driver expressions, verified against evaluated Blender poses; electrical horn index not calibrated

body_position_datum: Current geometry rotation pivot; body_translation_world_mm is the model translation offset.
